name: Prestige Mode: the level 20 riding mail is not resent while a prestige cycle relevels the character through it again
contract: data/sql/base/db_world/mail_level_reward.sql sends mail template 224 (sender 4732) to race mask 1 (Human) characters reaching level 20, with no per-character idempotency beyond Player::GiveLevel's own level check. Outside Prestige Mode this mail is sent exactly once, the first time a character reaches level 20 (GiveLevel(20)). CoAPrestige::Activate() calls GiveLevel(1) and the character then relevels through 20 again inside the same prestige cycle; #5622 reports the mail resending every cycle. The character stays in an active prestige cycle (CoAPrestige::IsActive) from the reset until it reaches the required level again, so no new copy of this mail should arrive while releveling through 20 a second time.

steps.label: Reach level 20 for the first time
The riding mail arrives the first time
Relevel through 20 again inside the same prestige cycle
The riding mail is not resent while prestiging
